text:
Maya: Heads up — code freeze for v1.8.0 starts in ~3h (17:00 PT). Please avoid non-critical merges. If you need a late exception, ping me with PR link + short risk summary + green CI.

Sam: Quick question — is a docs-only package.json patch (version bump for changelog) considered non-critical? PR <https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/5123|#5123>.

Eli: Docs-only + changelog tweak usually fine, but we had a flaky windows lint yesterday. Can we confirm CI is stable for that PR?

Jo: I can rerun CI if needed. If it's truly docs-only, prefer cherry-pick into release branch instead of direct main merge.

Rachel: Policy check: release exceptions allowed for docs/changelog bumps if (1) CI is green, (2) no compiled artifacts changed, (3) release manager + freeze owner approve. @Maya please confirm.

Maya: Confirming — I can approve docs/changelog-only exceptions. Requirements: add label `freeze-exception`, ensure all CI checks pass, and include a 1-line risk note in PR body.

Sam: Thanks. I added the `freeze-exception` label and a risk note: "docs only, changelog entry. No runtime changes." Re-run CI now.

ReleaseBot: PR #5123 — automated checks queued. Status: running checks (lint, unit, integration).

ReleaseBot: PR #5123 — all checks passed ✅ (lint, unit, integration).

Jo: Green — please cherry-pick to `release/v1.8.0` with `git cherry-pick -x` and push, then open a small follow-up PR against release branch. That keeps release history clean.

Sam: Will do. Commands I ran:
```bash
git fetch origin
git checkout -b hotfix/docs-bump
git cherry-pick -x <commit-sha>
git push origin hotfix/docs-bump
# opened PR against release/v1.8.0 -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/5125
```

Maya: Approved — exception granted. @Rachel can you note this in release notes tracker? Also, please make a quick callout if any downstream dep needs version sync.

Rachel: Noted and added line to release tracker. Thanks for keeping it minimal.

Sam: Merged the cherry-pick PR into release/v1.8.0. Thanks everyone :tada:

Maya: Closing thread — freeze remains in effect for other changes. If anything else urgent pops up, follow the same exception process.
